New concrete catalyst: expanded Slingshot III maritime-domain-awareness contract with the US Office of Naval Research (announced 9/14, six new NewSat Mark VI satellites over 18 months), driving a +3.9% move on 9/25 to ~$6.17. AST SpaceMobile sourced from the 9/8 weekly theme screen (direct-to-cell satellite connectivity).
